title: Rarity Ladder
description: One reference weapon expands through rare, epic, and legendary treatments while preserving the same platform silhouette.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a believable near-future rifle platform; images 02-04 use it as a strict reference and scale cosmetics, materials, and emissive treatment upward across the rarity ladder without redesigning the weapon.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
